name: fath-control
description: Read sensor values and control actuators on a local ABB/Busch-Jaeger free@home smart home system.
long_description: Connects to a free@home System Access Point (SysAP) on your local network via its local REST API. Gives Claude tools to list every sensor (temperature, movement, window/door, brightness, energy meters, ...) with its current reading, list every actuator (switches, lights, dimmers, blinds/shutters, heating/cooling valves, ...) with its current state, and set a value on an actuator by its channel name - on/off for switches, a percentage for dimmers, up/down/stop or a percentage for blinds.

tools.name: list_sensors
tools.description: List free@home sensors and their current readings

tools.name: list_actuators
tools.description: List free@home actuators and their current state

tools.name: set_actuator
tools.description: Set a value on a free@home actuator (on/off, up/down/stop, or a percentage)

host.title: SysAP host or IP
host.description: IP address or hostname of your free@home System Access Point, e.g. 192.168.1.50

username.title: Local API username
username.description: Local API user configured on the SysAP (in the free@home next app: More -> free@home Settings -> Local API)

password.title: Local API password
password.description: Password for the local API user

insecure.title: Skip TLS certificate verification
insecure.description: SysAPs present a self-signed certificate by default; leave this on unless you've installed a trusted certificate
